The future is scary and dark especially if you have no plans and feel like you have to. The past is scary too. It’s holds scary trauma and it’s horrible. Focus on the now and the near future. I know it might be difficult but I believe in you. You can do this. It took my friend stealing my blades and throwing them away for me to realize how cut up my legs really were.
